cli.description: Plays through a Ren'Py game automatically and reports what is broken.
cli.game: the game's folder, or any file or folder inside it
cli.sdk: a Ren'Py SDK folder, needed when the game does not ship its own engine (also read from the RENPY_SDK environment variable)
cli.stages: which checks to run, separated by commas; available: {all} (default: {default})
cli.strategy: how to play the game: 'explore' tries every choice of every menu, 'first' plays a single path taking the first choice everywhere (default: {default})
cli.jobs: how many copies of the game to run at the same time; 1 runs everything one after another (default: chosen from this computer's processor and free memory)
cli.max_paths: stop exploring after this many paths in each copy of the game that is running (default: {default})
cli.max_time: stop exploring after this many seconds (default: {default})
cli.max_depth: stop branching after this many decisions on one path; the path is still played to its end (default: {default})
cli.seed: seed for the game's random numbers, so runs are repeatable (default: {default})
cli.timeout: stop the game if it makes no progress for this many seconds (default: {default})
cli.input_value: text typed into the game's text prompts (default: {default})
cli.max_steps: end a path after this many statements, in case the game loops forever (default: {default})
cli.fail_on: lowest severity that makes the run fail (default: {default})
cli.fail_on_possible: also fail the run for possible issues, which were only seen when starting at a label or after skipping something the tool could not play
cli.languages: which of the game's languages to check, separated by commas (default: all of them)
cli.no_labels: do not start the game at each label by itself after exploring the story
cli.show_window: show the game's window while testing; it flashes rapidly, do not use if you are sensitive to flashing light
cli.lang: language for messages and reports (default: your system's language)
cli.show_window_warning: Warning: the game window will be visible and will flash rapidly.
cli.interrupted: Stopped. The game folder has been restored.
error.unknown_language: The game has no language named {languages}. Its languages: {known}.
error.internal: RenPyTester itself failed. This is a bug in RenPyTester, not a problem in your game. Please report it with the details below.
error.not_a_game: No Ren'Py game found at {path}. Point RenPyTester at the folder that contains the 'game' folder.
error.sdk_invalid: {path} is not a Ren'Py SDK: it has no 'renpy' and 'lib' folders.
error.no_engine: The game at {path} does not include a Ren'Py engine (no 'renpy' and 'lib' folders beside 'game'). Pass --sdk with the path to your Ren'Py SDK, or set the RENPY_SDK environment variable.
error.python2_engine: This game uses Ren'Py {version}, which runs on Python 2. RenPyTester supports Ren'Py 8 and later only.
error.engine_incomplete: The Ren'Py engine at {path} cannot run on this computer. Looked for a 'lib' folder named one of: {wanted}.
error.already_running: Another RenPyTester run (process {pid}) is already testing {path}. Wait for it to finish.
error.output_inside_game: The report folder {path} is inside the game folder. Choose a folder outside the game with --output.
error.engine_failed:
The game's engine stopped before testing could begin (exit code {code}). What it printed:
{output}
note.repaired: A previous run did not finish cleanly. Its leftover files were removed and the game folder was restored.
note.lint_options: This version of Ren'Py does not support some lint checks, so they were skipped: {options}
note.lint_failed: The engine's lint did not produce a report ({reason}). The script was not checked by lint.
note.translations_failed: The check of the translations did not finish ({reason}). The translations were not fully checked.
note.translations_not_played: The game was not played in this run, so translated lines were not tried out as the story reached them. A translation that uses a variable the game does not have at that point would not be found.
note.strings_need_source: This game has no script source files, so text marked for translation inside screens and Python code could not be listed. Only dialogue and menu choices were checked for missing translations.
note.limited.max_paths: Exploration stopped at the limit on paths. {count} branches were not explored. Raise --max-paths to go further.
note.limited.max_time: Exploration stopped at the time limit. {count} branches were not explored. Raise --max-time to go further.
note.limited.labels: {count} labels were not played by themselves, because a limit was reached first.
note.limited.relaunches: The game died or hung too many times. {count} branches were not explored.
finding.load_failure: The game failed while starting up: {message}
finding.unreachable: This statement can never be reached.
finding.orphan_translation: This translation ({id}) no longer matches any line in the game.
finding.undefined_image: The image '{name}' is shown here, but no image with that name is defined.
finding.missing_file: The file '{file}' is used here, but it cannot be found in the game.
finding.bad_text: This text has a broken text tag: {problem} The text is: {text}
finding.language_switch: The game could not be switched to {language}: {type}: {message}
finding.bad_interpolation: The {language} translation of this line cannot be shown when the game gets here: {type}: {message} The text is: {text}
finding.untranslated_line: This line of dialogue has no {language} translation: {text}
finding.variable_mismatch: This {language} translation does not use the same [variables] as the original. Left out: {missing}. Added: {extra}.
finding.no_choice: This menu had no choice the player could pick: every choice's condition was false.
finding.needs_display: The game used something that only works with a real screen, so this path could not be tested further: {message}
finding.hang: The game stopped making progress here for {seconds} seconds and was shut down.
finding.engine_crash: The game's engine stopped unexpectedly (exit code {code}).
finding.stuck: The game waited here for something RenPyTester cannot do, such as a minigame. It was skipped, and the story was continued once for each result the script checks for. The minigame itself was not tested.
finding.loop: The game ran {steps} statements without ending. It may be stuck in a loop.
console.progress: Playing... {paths} paths done, {waiting} branches waiting, {percent}% of statements, {findings} problems found
console.translation: {language}: {lines} of {lines_total} lines of dialogue and {strings} of {strings_total} other texts translated
console.untranslated_more: ... and {count} more with no {language} translation. They are all in the full report.
console.script: Script: {words} words in {blocks} dialogue blocks, {menus} menus, {languages} translations
console.possible.title: Possible issues ({count})
console.possible.why: These were found by starting the game at a label by itself, or after skipping something the tool could not play, such as a minigame. The game was then in a state the tool made up, so a real player may never hit them.
console.coverage_low: Plus {count} statements reached only by starting at a label or after a skipped interaction (lower confidence).
cli.epilog: Settings can also be kept in a file named renpytester.toml in the game's folder. 'renpytester info GAME' only says what the game is, without playing it. 'renpytester cache list' and 'renpytester cache clear' show and delete the copies that --sandbox keeps.
cli.config: a settings file to use instead of {name} in the game's folder; options given here win over the file
cli.baseline: an earlier JSON report: problems that are already in it are left out, so that only new ones are reported
cli.info.description: Says what a Ren'Py game is (its name, engine and languages) without playing it.
error.config_missing: The settings file {path} does not exist.
error.config_unreadable: The settings file {file} cannot be read: {message}
error.config_unknown_key: The settings file {file} has a setting this version does not know: {key}. Known settings: {known}.
error.config_bad_value: In the settings file {file}, the value of {key} is not right. It must be {expected}.
error.baseline_unreadable: The baseline {path} is not a JSON report written by RenPyTester.
config.expected.text: a piece of text in quotes
config.expected.texts: a list of texts, such as ["one", "two"]
config.expected.whole: a whole number that is not too small
config.expected.severity: a table that gives a kind of problem one of "error", "warning" or "info"
config.expected.inputs: a table that gives the text of a prompt the text to type there
config.expected.variables: a table that gives a variable of the game a plain value: text, a number, true or false, or a list
config.expected.ignore: a list of [[ignore]] tables, each with at least one of class, file, label, language or message
config.expected.pattern: a regular expression that can be read
note.interrupted: The run was stopped before it finished. This report has only what was found until then.
console.ignored: {count} problems were left out by the ignore rules of the settings file.
console.known: {count} problems that the baseline report already had were left out.
junit.stage_unfinished: The {stage} stage did not finish, so what it checks was not fully checked.
html.title: RenPyTester report: {game}
html.about: Ren'Py {renpy}. Tested on {when} UTC. Game folder: {path}
html.coverage: of the script played ({executed} of {total} statements)
html.unfinished: Not finished, so not fully checked: {stages}
html.filter.nothing: Nothing matches what is chosen above.
html.label: In label
cli.sandbox: test a copy of the game instead of the game, for games that write or delete files in their own folder; the copy is kept and only brought up to date on later runs
cli.sandbox_verify: with --sandbox, compare the contents of every file when bringing the copy up to date, not only sizes and dates; slower, for when dates cannot be trusted
cli.cache.description: Shows or deletes the copies of games that --sandbox keeps.
cli.cache.action: 'list' shows the copies and how much space they take; 'clear' deletes them
cli.cache.game: with 'clear', delete only the copy of this game
cache.where: Copies of games are kept in {path}
cache.entry.in_use: {game}: {size} in {files} files, last used {when} UTC, being tested right now
cache.kept: {count} copies are being tested right now and were kept.
console.stage.sandbox: Bringing the copy of the game up to date...
console.copying: Checking the copy of the game... {done} of {total} files
console.sandbox: A copy of the game was tested, and the game itself was not touched. The copy is in {path} ({size}, {files} files). To bring it up to date, {copied} files were copied and {removed} removed.
note.game_wrote_files: The game's own script wrote into the game folder while it was played: {created} files created, {changed} changed, {deleted} deleted ({files}). The created ones were removed again, but changed and deleted files could not be put back. Use --sandbox to test a copy of the game instead.
note.game_wrote_files.sandbox: The game's own script wrote into its folder while it was played: {created} files created, {changed} changed, {deleted} deleted ({files}). This happened in the copy; the game itself was not touched, and the copy is put right before the next run.
note.game_wrote_files.jobs: Several copies of the game were running in that one folder, so what one wrote another may have read. If results differ between runs, use --jobs 1.
kind.distribution: built game, using its own engine
severity.error.title: Errors ({count})
severity.warning.title: Warnings ({count})
severity.info.title: Notes ({count})
